mapper.select:
/* 성능분석 통계 리스트 (나중에 업무 생성일자로 바꿔야함. 현재는 수/출입 테이블의 업무 생성일자의 싱크가 안맞는 문제로 업무수행 날짜와 조인되어있음) */ WITH LIST(INPT_RCP_DT, MAS_COUNT, NOMAL_COUNT, RECLFI_COUNT, SUGI_COUNT, SCORE_COUNT) AS ( SELECT MAS.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT , NVL(MAS.MAS_COUNT, 0) AS MAS_COUNT , NVL(NOMAL.NOMAL_COUNT, 0) AS NOMAL_COUNT , NVL(RECLFI.RECLFI_COUNT, 0) AS RECLFI_COUNT , NVL(SUGI.SUGI_COUNT, 0) AS SUGI_COUNT , NVL(SCORE.SCORE_COUNT, 0) AS SCORE_COUNT FROM
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO) AS MAS_COUNT ,INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM WHERE AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY INPT_RCP_DT )MAS
,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS NOMAL_COUNT , A.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' OR AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40')) AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT )NOMAL
,( SELECT COUNT(A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS RECLFI_COUNT , A.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40') AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT )RECLFI
,( SELECT COUNT(A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS SUGI_COUNT , A.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' OR AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40')) AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT )SUGI
,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS SCORE_COUNT , B.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD002TG A , CSPD001TM B , CSPD112TI C , CSPD112TI D WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND C.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '901' AND (C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM > A.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE OR C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM = A.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE) AND D.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '902' AND D.AI_INPT_INTF_ITM_NM = 'IN' AND D.AI_INPT_CMN_USG_YN = 'Y' AND A.IMEX_HIS_CD = D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AND B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY B.INPT_RCP_DT )SCORE
WHERE MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = RECLFI.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = NOMAL.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = SUGI.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = SCORE.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '') -- ORDER BY MAS.INPT_RCP_DT )
SELECT NVL(INPT_RCP_DT,'합계(건)') AS INPT_RCP_DT , SUM(MAS_COUNT) AS MAS_COUNT , SUM(NOMAL_COUNT) AS NOMAL_COUNT , SUM(RECLFI_COUNT) AS RECLFI_COUNT , SUM(SUGI_COUNT)AS SUGI_COUNT , SUM(SCORE_COUNT) AS SCORE_COUNT FROM LIST GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((INPT_RCP_DT, MAS_COUNT, NOMAL_COUNT, RECLFI_COUNT, SUGI_COUNT, SCORE_COUNT),())
UNION ALL
SELECT '비율(%)' AS INPT_RCP_DT , ROUND(SUM(MAS_COUNT) / (SUM(MAS_COUNT)) * 100, 1) AS MAS_COUNT , ROUND(SUM(NOMAL_COUNT) / (SUM(MAS_COUNT)) * 100, 1) AS NOMAL_COUNT , ROUND(SUM(RECLFI_COUNT) / (SUM(MAS_COUNT)) * 100, 1) AS RECLFI_COUNT , ROUND(SUM(SUGI_COUNT) / (SUM(MAS_COUNT)) * 100, 1) AS SUGI_COUNT , ROUND(SUM(SCORE_COUNT) / (SUM(MAS_COUNT)) * 100, 1) AS SCORE_COUNT FROM LIST
ORDER BY CASE WHEN INPT_RCP_DT = '비율(%)' THEN 0 WHEN INPT_RCP_DT = '합계(건)' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END DESC
, MAS_COUNT
, MAS_COUNT DESC
, NOMAL_COUNT
, NOMAL_COUNT DESC
, RECLFI_COUNT
, RECLFI_COUNT DESC
, SUGI_COUNT
, SUGI_COUNT DESC
, SCORE_COUNT
, SCORE_COUNT DESC
, INPT_RCP_DT
, INPT_RCP_DT DESC
, INPT_RCP_DT ASC

,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS NOMAL_COUNT , A.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' OR AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40')) AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT )NOMAL
,( SELECT COUNT(A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS RECLFI_COUNT , A.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40') AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT )RECLFI
,( SELECT COUNT(A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS SUGI_COUNT , A.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD001TM A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80' OR AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40')) AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY A.INPT_RCP_DT )SUGI
,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS SCORE_COUNT , B.INPT_RCP_DT FROM CSPD002TG A , CSPD001TM B , CSPD112TI C , CSPD112TI D WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND C.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '901' AND (C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM > A.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE OR C.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM = A.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE) AND D.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '902' AND A.IMEX_HIS_CD = D.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AND B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('160', '140') GROUP BY B.INPT_RCP_DT )SCORE
WHERE MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = RECLFI.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = NOMAL.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = SUGI.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT = SCORE.INPT_RCP_DT (+) AND MAS.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
